intro.h2: Design first, then a kitchen that fits your budget
paragraphs: Rommy's Kitchens & Closets by Design handles kitchen remodeling in Chula Vista with the design worked out first. Rommy plans the room with you before his team builds it. One client said he turned an archaic eyesore into the magnificent centerpiece of their home, well within their budget.

The company also works on bathrooms, closets, tile and built-in entertainment walls. Small rooms get the same attention. As Rommy's own page puts it, a small space does not have to mean giving up quality. Clients mention regular check-ins during the job and a designer who is easy to reach when questions come up.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling and design
items.blurb: Full kitchen remodels planned with Rommy from the start: layout, cabinets, counters, backsplash, lighting and appliances. One finished kitchen pairs deep green shaker cabinets with white marble counters, a marble subway backsplash and open wood shelves on either side of the window.

image.alt: Green shaker kitchen with brass pulls, white marble peninsula, stainless range hood and wood floating shelves

items.name: Custom cabinets and countertops
items.blurb: Custom cabinets sized to your room, topped with the counter material you choose. One finished L-shaped kitchen pairs warm maple-tone cabinets with a speckled granite counter, an undermount sink and a stainless microwave hood over the range.

image.alt: L-shaped kitchen with medium wood cabinets, speckled granite countertops, undermount sink and stainless appliances

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Bathroom remodels from vanity to tile, with the same design-first approach used in the kitchens. Bring your measurements and photos to the Main Street office, and Rommy will talk you through layout, materials and what fits your budget.

why_choose_us.h2: Why Chula Vista homeowners work with Rommy

items.title: A real design before anything is built
items.text: Rommy works out the layout, cabinets and finishes with you first, so you can see the plan and adjust it before any work begins. Clients single out his designs in their reviews.

items.title: Fair prices that respect your budget
items.text: Clients describe prices as fair and honest and the work as well within budget. Google's review highlights also mention great customer service and prices.

items.title: Regular check-ins and flexibility
items.text: One homeowner said Rommy was very responsive, checked in regularly to keep the project on track, and was very accommodating when she added items mid-project.

items.title: Local, Latino-owned and easy to reach
items.text: The office is on Main Street in Chula Vista, open weekdays 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturdays 10 AM to 2 PM. On Google, the company identifies as Latino-owned and LGBTQ+ friendly.

about.text: Rommy's Kitchens & Closets by Design is a Latino-owned remodeling company with an office at 2260 Main St in Chula Vista. Rommy leads the design work and builds each project with his team. The company also goes by Rommy's Designs, with the line Kitchens, Baths & More, and its goal is to make building the kitchen, bathroom or entertainment space you want simpler. Clients describe him as responsive and accommodating, and one says she will definitely use Rommy and his team again for her next project.

image.alt: L-shaped kitchen with maple-tone cabinets, speckled granite counters and stainless appliances

steps.title: Call or stop by
steps.text: Call (619) 575-7707 or visit the office at 2260 Main St during business hours to talk about the room you want to change.

steps.title: Design with Rommy
steps.text: Rommy works out the layout, cabinets, counters and tile with you, so you can see the plan before any work starts.

steps.title: Agree on the budget
steps.text: You review the price together and adjust the plan until it fits. Clients say Rommy worked with their budget.

steps.title: Build with regular check-ins
steps.text: The team builds the project while Rommy checks in to keep it on track. Extra items can be added along the way.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: Walk through the finished room with Rommy and check the drawers, doors and fixtures before the job wraps up.

service_area.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Chula Vista, from Main Street
service_area.text: Rommy's Kitchens & Closets by Design works out of 2260 Main St, Suite 7, in Chula Vista, California. Chula Vista is the town named on its Google profile and its Facebook page. If your home is in a nearby part of San Diego County and you are not sure it is in range, call (619) 575-7707 or email rommyskitchens@gmail.com and ask before you book a consultation.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you do?
items.a: Kitchen remodeling is the main service, along with bathroom remodeling, custom cabinets, tile installation, closets and built-ins like fireplace and TV walls. Rommy designs each project with you before his team builds it, so you can see and adjust the plan first.

items.q: Where are you located and when are you open?
items.a: The office is at 2260 Main St, Suite 7, Chula Vista, CA 91911. Hours are Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday 10 AM to 2 PM. It is closed on Sunday. You can also call (619) 575-7707 to set a time.

items.q: Can you work with my budget?
items.a: That is one of the things clients mention most. One reviewer said Rommy worked with her budget and that his prices were fair and honest. Another said the work came in well within their budget. Bring your number to the first conversation so the design fits it.

items.q: My kitchen or bathroom is small. Is it worth remodeling?
items.a: Yes. Rommy's own page makes the point that a small space does not have to mean giving up quality or luxury. Any room, whatever its size, can be redesigned to work better. Bring measurements and photos and talk through the options.

items.q: Can I add things once the project has started?
items.a: Clients say yes. One homeowner added a few items during her project and said Rommy was very accommodating. Talk to him about any additions so the schedule and price can be updated together, and he will keep checking in to keep things on track.

final_cta.h2: Start with a design you love
final_cta.text: Call Rommy or stop by the Main Street office to plan your kitchen, bath or closet.
